Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/libzip && python3 -c "
import os
st = os.stat('lib/zip_buffer.c')
print('mode:', oct(st.st_mode))
print('uid:', st.st_uid, 'gid:', st.st_gid)
print('size:', st.st_size)
# Try to open
try:
    fd = os.open('lib/zip_buffer.c', os.O_RDONLY)
    data = os.read(fd, 100)
    print('read:', len(data), 'bytes')
    os.close(fd)
except Exception as e:
    print('error:', e)
"
